10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

10378|6bdb24d7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|6bdb24d7.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10668|19e45338.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|19e45338.text:
The body is that of a female orc warrior.

It is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

10668|36aec325.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|36aec325.text:
You turn the body over and see the marks from blades and spells upon the deceased orc--her armor all but destroyed, her hair matted to her face.

Based on Mankrik's description of her, there is no doubt in your mind that this was his wife.

He will be upset by the news, but you are sure he should know the truth.

11860|ae16ea2b.name: Maggran Earthbinder
11860|ae16ea2b.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12616|c5ceacbe.name: Vhulgra
12616|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12696|f1d5ba87.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|f1d5ba87.text: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12736|e3f9a765.name: Je'neu Sancrea
12736|e3f9a765.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

12737|aa838c4f.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
12737|aa838c4f.text:
If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.

If you want something, make it quick.

12757|9b4e17a6.name: Karang Amakkar
12757|9b4e17a6.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3324|031480cd.name: Grol'dar
3324|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3332|51d936f4.name: Lumak
3332|51d936f4.text: Fish so delicious. You come learn fish? Eat fish? Mmmmm...

3363|05c29513.name: Magar
3363|05c29513.text: About time you showed me some results! Now I'll show you results!

3430|d6fdd5ef.name: Mangletooth
3430|d6fdd5ef.text:
You have <snort> aided Mangletooth more than I would have dreamed, $r.

Thank you.

As long as I remain a captive here, you may bring me blood shards from the Bristleback quilboar and I will bless you with Agamaggan's power.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3433|4ec00f6f.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|4ec00f6f.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

5815|721fd095.name: Kurgul
5815|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

8306|0c543544.name: Duhng
8306|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1062-accept.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1062-accept.text:
The goblin-run Venture Company moved into the Stonetalon Mountains, chopping down trees and burning huge stretches of forest.  The spirits of this place are nearly blind with pain and rage.  We must stop the Venture Company!

Head northwest, beyond the Greatwood Vale and into the Windshear Crag.  You will find the goblins and their servants at work -- show them the Horde will not allow the exploitation of Stonetalon.  Show them in the language they best understand...

Violence.
1062-accept.title: Goblin Invaders

1069-accept.name: Many
1069-accept.text:
Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
1069-accept.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1069-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-complete.text:
You got them!  Thank you!

I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay.  I can already taste the profits!

Here is your cut, $N.  I couldn't have made this deal without you.
1069-complete.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1087-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-accept.text:
You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.

Would that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.

I have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
1087-accept.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1510-complete.name: Ken'zigla
1510-complete.text:
Another orc, eh? I hope you haven't come for the other. He didn't make it. Those goblins did him in good.

He said he needed a healing draught, but not much else.
1510-complete.title: News of Dogran

1511-accept.name: Ken'zigla
1511-accept.text:
I figured there might be another coming to get the draught, so I prepared it anyways.

Here you go, $N. Mind you, you should only give half of it to him! That will give him enough strength to move without bleeding himself dry. Wait a night, then give him the other half.

Anyways, you'll want to bring this to Logmar at Camp Taurajo. From what the first one told me, he should have an idea where this Dogran is.
1511-accept.title: Ken'zigla's Draught

1511-complete.name: Grunt Logmar
1511-complete.text:
Well, it's about time! Dogran has been dying out there, waiting for this.

We need to get this out to him right away, but most of the grunts stationed here are out on a foraging mission.
1511-complete.title: Ken'zigla's Draught

1512-accept.name: Grunt Dogran
1512-accept.text:
Zankaja is young and beautiful. To be chained to an invalid... I will not allow her to suffer that injustice.

Leave me, $N. And thank you. I may end my life in glorious battle, instead of a lifeless husk.

And please, I would ask you not to tell my mate of this... I do not want guilt on her conscience.
1512-accept.title: Love's Gift

1512-complete.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1512-complete.text: If you tell me that this will suffice, then I trust you, $N. Allow me to clean it though... Pristine and shining, it may be even more enticing to a succubus.
1512-complete.title: Love's Gift

1512-progress.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1512-progress.text: You have returned. Are you ready to battle a succubus?
1512-progress.title: Love's Gift

1513-accept.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1513-accept.text:
Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, $N. Summon forth a foul succubus, then show it your mastery. I believe in the strength of your magic. As always, though, be wary, for pride and overconfidence has overcome many a promising $c.

When you have defeated it, return the pendant to me so that I might deliver the news to Zankaja.
1513-accept.title: The Binding

1513-complete.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1513-complete.text:
Success! Be sure I expected nothing less from my star pupil.

You have proven your worth, and gladly will I show you the method of summoning your subdued succubus. Go now, you have much to learn, and when next I see you, I will expect you to have found true mastery over your succubus.

Leave the sorrow of Dogran and Zankaja to those of us who are longer in years, but remember it, and hold it as protection against the wiles of the dark power you have learned to summon today.
1513-complete.title: The Binding

1513-progress.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
1513-progress.text:
When I look upon a succubus, my heart begins to soar... But at the same time, I can almost sense my soul's ebb, drifting away like the tides.

Be wary, my friend.
1513-progress.title: The Binding

1515-accept.name: Grunt Logmar
1515-accept.text:
You've made it this far, so if you want to see this through to the end, I won't stop you. I can't spare you any additional manpower though, you'll be on your own.

Dogran is being held in a quilboar camp to the north of here. Look for a group of two huts. He'll be heavily guarded--that is, if they haven't killed him yet, or he hasn't succumbed to his wounds.

Good luck.
1515-accept.title: Dogran's Captivity

1515-complete.name: Grunt Dogran
1515-complete.text:
Foul tasting brew...

I can feel the strength in me now, enough to hobble away... But my leg, I will have lost it for the rest of my life. My arm, too.
1515-complete.title: Dogran's Captivity

216-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
216-accept.text:
The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion!  Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post.  It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path.

$N, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!

Proceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs.  You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!
216-accept.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

23-accept.name: Unknown
23-accept.text:
<The paw of the mighty bear Ursangous is your trophy for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.  On the paw is a small quarter-crescent emblem; the significance of the emblem remains a mystery.

The paw should be brought to Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post to prove that you have bested the mighty creature and completed this portion of the hunt.>
23-accept.title: Ursangous's Paw

25-accept.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
25-accept.text:
If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?

The transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path.  What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.

You up for being useful?
25-accept.title: Stonetalon Standstill

3513-accept.name: Unknown
3513-accept.text:
The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?

There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.
3513-accept.title: The Runed Scroll

3513-complete.name: Kadrak
3513-complete.text: Well now... Where did you find this?
3513-complete.title: The Runed Scroll

3514-accept.name: Kadrak
3514-accept.text:
This scroll is from that scheming dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.

She'll not be making any more contact with the messenger you looted this from, heh, but we must stand our ground here. The Horde will not tolerate her outrunners here.

$N, travel to the Talon Den. Kill Rynthariel, and then put up a symbol for all to see. Take this Horde flag, $N. Put it up in the Talon Den so that they will not be so rash as to send another messenger through our territory again.
3514-accept.title: Horde Presence

5044-progress.name: Mangletooth
5044-progress.text:
The shaman and geomancers of the quilboar tribes <snort> call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, $r.

If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you. <snort>
5044-progress.title: Wisdom of Agamaggan

5881-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
5881-accept.text:
The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.

I need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
5881-accept.title: Calling in the Reserves

6282-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6282-accept.text:
Tauren take pride as the protector of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.

The Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in Kalimdor; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.

I need you to cull the harpies, $N!
6282-accept.title: Harpies Threaten

6284-accept.name: Unknown
6284-accept.text:
Warning: Proceed into Sishir Canyon west of here at your own risk.

Besseleth and her eight-legged children of the forest have claimed this canyon as their webbed lair.

Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat has placed a bounty on Besseleth. Slay her and bring proof of your killing to Maggran; there you will receive your reward for disposing this eight-legged menace.
6284-accept.title: Arachnophobia

6301-accept.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-accept.text:
Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.

$N, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.

Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
6301-accept.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6382-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
6382-complete.text:
Welcome to the new frontier, $N.  Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young $c like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle.  Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.

Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt.  Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.
6382-complete.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

6383-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
6383-complete.text:
There are three legendary creatures that make up the Ashenvale Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might.  In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself.  The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.

The creatures of the Ashenvale Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down.  If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.
6383-complete.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

6393-accept.name: Tsunaman
6393-accept.text:
The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.

$N, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
6393-accept.title: Elemental War

6441-accept.name: Pixel
6441-accept.text:
Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.

After asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!

Tell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.
6441-accept.title: Satyr Horns

6442-accept.name: Marukai
6442-accept.text:
There is evil lurking here along the coast, $r.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas.  Lost, and nearly forgotten.

Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know.  But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.

Return to me with 20 of their heads! Throw the naga back to the depths!
6442-accept.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6461-accept.name: Many
6461-accept.text:
We Trolls here at Malaka'Jin have prospered from the land; Stonetalon Mountain offers great hunting for us to live on.

Lately, we have attracted the wrong dinner guests... the spiders in these mountains have been raiding our camps at night looking to steal our hunt.

If you were to help us kill off these ghastly beasts we at Malaka'Jin would be in your debt. Spiders are everywhere in Stonetalon - just head north from here and you will see what I am talking about.
6461-accept.title: Blood Feeders

6461-complete.name: Xen'Zilla
6461-complete.text:
Sweet, mon! Good news, perhaps we will have fewer unwanted dinner guests tonight.

Many thanks, $N.  We are forever in your debt.
6461-complete.title: Blood Feeders

6462-accept.name: Mitsuwa
6462-accept.text:
My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred $r charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar!  Those vile Furbolgs!

I miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife.  However, their $r charms hold great value in this world.  It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!

$N, you must retrieve the charms!  They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.
6462-accept.title: Troll Charm

6503-accept.name: Kuray'bin
6503-accept.text:
We received reports that Ashenvale outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest.  We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!

Sneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the Alliance outpost of Silverwing.  Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.
6503-accept.title: Ashenvale Outrunners

6541-complete.name: Kadrak
6541-complete.text: Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.
6541-complete.title: Report to Kadrak

6543-accept.name: Kadrak
6543-accept.text:
I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.

Your first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. You will find a scout and an outrider there.

Give them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.
6543-accept.title: The Warsong Reports

6545-complete.name: Warsong Runner
6545-complete.text: Well, my update will explain all of this to Kadrak. You must return this to him as quickly as possible.
6545-complete.title: Warsong Runner Update

6545-progress.name: Warsong Runner
6545-progress.text:
So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.

You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, $N. I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here.

But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.
6545-progress.title: Warsong Runner Update

6547-complete.name: Warsong Scout
6547-complete.text: Let Kadrak know of the success we have had here holding off the night elves. Our plans are going well.
6547-complete.title: Warsong Scout Update

6547-progress.name: Warsong Scout
6547-progress.text:
Keep an eye out, $r. The elves are often hiding in the shadows...

We must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.

I assume you have my next orders from Kadrak?
6547-progress.title: Warsong Scout Update

6548-accept.name: Makaba Flathoof
6548-accept.text:
The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.

$N, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.
6548-accept.title: Avenge My Village

6561-accept.name: Zul
6561-accept.text:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, $N, please.
6561-accept.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6562-accept.name: Tsunaman
6562-accept.text: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, $N. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
6562-accept.title: Trouble in the Deeps

6562-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6562-complete.text: Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. Then we have matters to discuss.
6562-complete.title: Trouble in the Deeps

6563-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-accept.text:
Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.

Will you help me, $N? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
6563-accept.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6571-accept.name: Locke Okarr
6571-accept.text:
We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!

Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.

Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!

Can you help me?
6571-accept.title: Warsong Supplies

6641-accept.name: Muglash
6641-accept.text:
Vorsha the Lasher... the fiendish hydra that roams the seas...

She has attacked our outpost, each time unprovoked, laying waste to anything that falls in her path.

But I am ready, $N. I have prepared to best the hydra and end these attacks on Zoram'gar.

The naga honor the wicked nature of this beast with a brazier that remains lit on an island just off the coast. I believe that if we put it out, Vorsha will appear in anger.

We will need help, so be sure to bring some strong allies.
6641-accept.title: Vorsha the Lasher

6641-complete.name: Warsong Runner
6641-complete.text:
I have witnessed many naga attacks since I arrived here. It puts my mind at ease that Vorsha will no longer roam freely.

We are in your debt, $N.
6641-complete.title: Vorsha the Lasher

6921-accept.name: Kam
6921-accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

$N, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
6921-accept.title: Amongst the Ruins

6921-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-complete.text:
This is exactly what I need!  A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from.  Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.

You've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us.  You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.
6921-complete.title: Amongst the Ruins

6921-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-progress.text: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
6921-progress.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-accept.name: Unknown
6922-accept.text:
The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.  He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
6922-accept.title: Baron Aquanis

6922-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-complete.text:
This... this is quite the find, $N.

You acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say?  Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him.  While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, our studies will also show how they did it as well.

You did well in bringing this to me.  Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.
6922-complete.title: Baron Aquanis

6922-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-progress.text: Ah, hello again $N.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
6922-progress.title: Baron Aquanis

862-accept.name: Grub
862-accept.text:
A $c like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.

Tell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.

Seems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.

You can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!
862-accept.title: Dig Rat Stew

868-accept.name: Korran
868-accept.text:
Hey, $N. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.

One object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.

Take this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
868-accept.title: Egg Hunt

868-complete.name: Korran
868-complete.text:
You please me, $N. The eggs and the tool. Well done.

And for your reward...
868-complete.title: Egg Hunt

868-progress.name: Korran
868-progress.text: Be careful with the eggs you find, $N. If they break, they be no good to me.
868-progress.title: Egg Hunt

893-complete.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-complete.text:
Excellent, excellent specimens indeed.

The quilboar are further along than I had expected.

Here, $c, take this and get out of my way. I'd better take a closer look at these weapons. We may have underestimated our enemy, and that's the kind of mistake we can't afford to make.
893-complete.title: Weapons of Choice

893-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-progress.text:
I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.

I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
893-progress.title: Weapons of Choice
